authorized-by.reason: v0.3 Phase 2 / change #B + #E: migrate require-review-sign.sh from grepping task XMLs to querying SQLite. Necessary because the new markdown specs do NOT carry status/sign-off in the file (state lives in DB). Hooks must read DB directly via a small bash→sqlite3 helper to avoid spawning the Node MCP server on every git push.

task.title: Migrate require-review-sign.sh to SQLite via scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh helper
task.description:
The current `require-review-sign.sh` greps every `*.xml` and `*.md` task file for `<reviewed-by>` / `reviewed_by:` markers. After Phase 2, markdown specs do NOT carry sign-off in-file — the `validation_attempts` and `tasks` rows in SQLite are the source of truth. Greppping a markdown file for sign-off will give a false negative and block every push.
Replace the grep loop with a SQLite query against `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/trajectory.db`.
Decision: query SQLite from bash via `sqlite3` CLI (universally available on macOS and most Linux distros, ships with Python and is the same dependency the integration test in `phase-2-schema-discussions-and-spec-path` already uses). Do NOT invoke the Node MCP server from the hook — startup latency would be too high on every git push and would create a dependency loop (`require-review-sign.sh` runs as a git hook even when MCP is offline).
Create `scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh`:
```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash # Library: SQLite query helpers for TMB hooks. # Sourced (not exec'd) by other hook scripts. set -euo pipefail
tmb_db_path() { # CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA may be unset (early init). Fall back to the # documented default. If neither path exists, callers must handle # the empty result. local p="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-$HOME/.claude/plugins/data/tmb}/trajectory.db" [ -f "$p" ] && echo "$p" }
tmb_have_sqlite() { command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1 }
# Print branch_ids of tasks that are completed in DB but missing # validation_attempts row with verdict=pass. tmb_unsigned_tasks() { local db db=$(tmb_db_path) || true [ -z "$db" ] && return 0 tmb_have_sqlite || return 0 sqlite3 "$db" " SELECT t.branch_id FROM tasks t WHERE t.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM validation_attempts v WHERE v.task_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) AND v.verdict = 'pass' ); " } ```
Rewrite `scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh` to: 1. Source `scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh`. 2. Skip gracefully if DB or sqlite3 not present (back-compat with fresh installs that never ran MCP). 3. Call `tmb_unsigned_tasks`. If non-empty, block with a list of branch_ids missing sign-off. 4. Drop the entire `for f in docs/trustmybot/tasks/*.xml *.md` grep loop.
LEGACY XML FALLBACK: keep a degraded grep-pass behind a guard. If the DB is absent (sqlite3 query returns empty AND the DB file does not exist), fall back to the v0.2 XML grep ONLY for `*.xml` files — explicitly do not grep `*.md` files since markdown specs by design have no in-file sign-off. This is the bridge for fresh clones that have not yet populated the DB. Print a one-line warning to stderr when this fallback fires so the user knows.
The hook MUST stay fast (sub-100ms). Single sqlite3 query is fine. Do not iterate files unless on the legacy fallback path.

files.file: New helper library exactly as in the description. `chmod +x` is not strictly necessary (sourced, not exec'd), but a leading shebang remains for editor highlighting.

Wholesale rewrite the body (after the existing `set -euo pipefail` and the push/merge command gate). Source the new lib. Use `tmb_unsigned_tasks`. On non-empty result, emit a JSON `{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: ..."}` listing the branch_ids and pointing the user at PR Reviewer to sign them. On legacy fallback, retain the current XML grep loop (XML only; drop the .md branch).

task.success-criteria: - `scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh` exists with `tmb_db_path`, `tmb_have_sqlite`, `tmb_unsigned_tasks` functions. - `scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh` sources the new lib, calls `tmb_unsigned_tasks`, and uses its output to decide block vs allow. - On a system WITH a populated DB: hook blocks when there is at least one task with `status='completed'` and no `validation_attempts` row with `verdict='pass'`. - On a system WITH a populated DB and all completed tasks signed: hook exits 0 silently. - On a system WITHOUT sqlite3 or WITHOUT a DB file: hook falls back to the legacy XML grep, prints a single-line stderr warning, and does not block on `.md` files. - Both scripts pass `bash -n` syntax check. - Both scripts execute under 100ms wall time (`time bash …` with a populated DB and 10 task rows).
task.out-of-scope: - Removing legacy XML grep entirely (keep it as fallback until v0.4). - Migrating `require-task-spec.sh` to SQLite — that hook gates on the FILE existence (Architect-authored spec) and properly stays file-based. - Adding new MCP tools (Phase 2 task `mcp-discussions-and-snapshot`). - Changing `git-guards.sh` or `create-worktree.sh`.
task.verification:
From `/Users/Zax/Git/GitHub/TMB/plugin/` (inside the worktree):
```bash # File presence + syntax test -f scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh && echo "OK: lib exists" bash -n scripts/hooks/lib/query-task.sh && echo "OK: lib syntax" bash -n scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh && echo "OK: hook syntax" grep -q 'tmb_unsigned_tasks' scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh && echo "OK: hook calls helper" grep -q 'source.*query-task.sh\|\. .*query-task.sh' scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh && echo "OK: hook sources lib"
# Smoke test: temp DB with one unsigned completed task TMP_DB=$(mktemp /tmp/trajXXXXXX.db) sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" < mcp/trajectory-server/src/schema.sql sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" "INSERT INTO issues (objective, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('t', datetime('now'), datetime('now'));" sqlite3 "$TMP_DB" "INSERT INTO tasks (issue_id, branch_id, description, success_criteria, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (1, 'feat/test-x', 'd', 'sc', 'completed', datetime('now'), datetime('now'));" OUTPUT=$(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=$(dirname "$TMP_DB") bash -c " mv '$TMP_DB' \$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/trajectory.db echo '{\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git push origin main\"}}' | bash scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh ") echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q '"decision":"block"' && echo "OK: blocks unsigned" echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q 'feat/test-x' && echo "OK: cites the task"
# Smoke test 2: same DB but with a passing validation_attempts row sqlite3 $(dirname "$TMP_DB")/trajectory.db "INSERT INTO validation_attempts (task_id, attempt_n, agent, verdict, created_at) VALUES ('1', 1, 'pr-reviewer', 'pass', datetime('now'));" OUTPUT2=$(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=$(dirname "$TMP_DB") bash -c " echo '{\"tool_input\":{\"command\":\"git push origin main\"}}' | bash scripts/hooks/require-review-sign.sh ") [ -z "$OUTPUT2" ] && echo "OK: signed task does not block"
rm -f $(dirname "$TMP_DB")/trajectory.db ```
All checks must print OK.
task.commit:
🔧 refactor(hooks): require-review-sign.sh queries SQLite via lib/query-task.sh helper
Phase 2 markdown specs hold no in-file sign-off; canonical state is in the validation_attempts table. Hook now queries that table directly via sqlite3 CLI, with a graceful fallback to the legacy XML grep when no DB is present (fresh-clone bridge).
